intent: Define the authoritative technical specification for UBVM — its capsule schema, primitive model, interpreter contract, trigger system, event bus, compliance requirements, and test suite.

interpretation.this_is: The official UBVM 0.2 specification — the implementable technical contract for all UBVM-compliant runtimes.
purpose: Define the capsule schema and minimum valid structure
Specify the primitive model and DISPATCH contract
Define the interpreter contract and result object
Specify the trigger system: on_load, cron, on_event
Define the event bus architecture and scheduler daemon
Establish compliance requirements and forbidden behaviours
Provide a compliance test suite for runtime certification
Define the versioning policy for UBVM
audience: Architects integrating UBVM into larger systems
Future maintainers of the reference implementation
ignore: SCP semantic layer details duplicated in SCP_SPEC.md
Implementation-specific quirks of the reference runtime
Experimental features not yet in UBVM Core 1.0

guarantees: This document defines the canonical UBVM technical contract.
Any runtime implementing this spec is UBVM-compliant.
The interpreter contract in §3.1 is the authoritative execution model.
The compliance test suite in §15 is the authoritative certification mechanism.
Known gaps are tracked as first-class facts, not omissions.
Version 1.0 is cut only when all gaps are resolved and ubvm test passes in full.
non_guarantees: SCP semantic layer rules — see scp/spec.
Reference implementation quirks not part of the contract.
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: If contradictions arise between this spec and any README, code comment, or external document, this spec takes precedence. If contradictions arise between this spec and scp/spec, the conflicting layer governs: scp/spec governs semantic and transport rules; ubvm/spec governs execution rules.

provenance.author: James / Giblets Creations
provenance.context: Created as the technical specification capsule for UBVM v0.2 during the UBVM documentation session, May 2026. Revised to move semantic_contract into interpretation, correct capture_mode, and add daily validation behaviour.
